note: K-Ras4B 1-169 numbering (KRAS-J1 numbering_note; the N-terminal tag residue is 0 and is outside core and mobile). Mobile = Switch I 25-40 (Y32, T35, I36, E37, D38) and Switch II 57-76 (G60, Q61, E62, Y64, Y71); the P-loop 10-17 carries CPMG residues but its Calpha does not move between the two states and stays in the core; 36OL helix/strand records: helices 15-26, 61-66, 67-75, 86-105, 126-138, 151-168, strands 3-10, 37-46, 49-58, 77-83, 111-116, 141-143. The literature contrast is state 1 (open Switch I, T35 off the Mg2+/gamma-phosphate; GDP-like shifts, KRAS-r1) versus state 2 (T35 on the gamma-phosphate); the state-1 crystals the rows cite (6MBQ Mg-free GMPPNP, KRAS-r36; 6ASA/6ASE D33E/A59G, KRAS-r74/r75; 6BP1, KRAS-r76) and the WT references 4OBE (GDP) and 6GOD (GMPPNP) are all outside the 150 downloaded files, which are the newest 150 of 556 by release date (2025-07 onward). Within the downloaded set: 'open' = 9OEL chain A, wild type GDP.Mg at 298 K with no inhibitor or partner (the GDP state that state 1 resembles by chemical shift), 'closed' = 36OL chain A, wild type GMPPNP.Mg with no inhibitor or partner (state 2 expected; its paper was not read). The only downloaded structure deposited as state 1 is the NMR ensemble 9Q30 (T35S/C118S GppNHp, model 1 used), with 9Q2X/9Q2Z the G12D/G12C versions; T35S itself shows extra processes (KRAS-J20). The nucleotide (GDP, GNP = GppNHp, GCP = GppCH2p, GSP = GTPgammaS, GTP, AF3 transition-state mimic) is reported in its own column and is not a ligand: apo = nucleotide only, ligand-bound = plus a small-molecule inhibitor or fragment, complex = plus a protein partner (RAF RBD, CypA tri-complexes, SOS, PI3K, antibodies, VHL ternary complexes). The 556-entry metadata table (<ENTRY>_metadata_all.md) classifies every mapped entry by nucleotide, partner and mutation; the deposited mutation field is empty for many G12C/G12D/G13C entries, so a second column parses the title (regex X123Y) and is marked as such. T35 chi1 (N-CA-CB-OG1), Y32, Q61, Y64 and Y71 chi1 are listed per altloc.
